title: Couples Holding Hands
summary: Given an array representing n couples seated in 2n seats, determine the least number of swaps needed to ensure each couple is seated next to each other.
statement: Given an array representing n couples seated in 2n seats, determine the least number of swaps needed to ensure each couple is seated next to each other. A swap involves exchanging the seats of any two individuals.
constraints: row is a permutation of 0..2n-1; partners are 2c and 2c+1.
One swap exchanges any two seated people.
Return the fewest swaps so every adjacent seat pair is a couple.
hints: Each adjacent seat pair connects the two couple IDs currently occupying it.
Within a connected component of c couples, c-1 swaps suffice and are necessary.
Union each seated pair and return couples minus component count.
Summing c-1 over all components yields n-components.
editorial: Summing c-1 over all components yields n-components.

tests.explanation: One swap seats couples zero-one and two-three together.
Both couples are already adjacent, so return zero.
